description: This file defines a database migration class for transitioning the database schema from version 24 to 25 in an Android application using the Room persistence library. The migration adds a new column 'directEditingAvailable' to the 'Account' table and resets the 'capabilitiesETag' field.

classes.name: Migration_24_25
classes.description: A migration class for updating the database schema from version 24 to 25.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes SQL commands to alter the database schema and data during the migration from version 24 to 25.

calls: db.execSQL"ALTER TABLE Account ADD COLUMN directEditingAvailable INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL"
